$comment: Lighthouse CI base config (V2-06 06-07; PWA-09, PWA_STRATEGY §3.9; ruling R-6). Never used directly: scripts/perf/lhci-config.mjs adds the loopback URLs, Chromium path, host-resolver lockdown and (signed-in routes) the Cookie header, writes the result to a git-ignored temp path and deletes it after the run. Lighthouse mobile defaults (no preset): Moto G Power emulation, simulated slow 4G, 4x CPU. Report-only: every assertion is `warn` (V2-15 turns them to `error`). Upload is the local filesystem only, never temporary-public-storage.
